resources.string: Lets your paired computer tap, swipe and type while you are mirroring

phonemirror control turns mouse and keyboard input from your paired computer into taps, swipes, buttons and typing on this phone.

It only acts while you are mirroring with the phonemirror app to the computer you paired with, over an encrypted connection. It does not collect, store or send what is on your screen except as the video you chose to share, and it never types into password fields.

You can turn it off here at any time.
